correctness.rationale: The Loday vertex coordinate at each internal node equals the product of the left/right subtree leaf counts; unordered leaf pairs partition by lowest common ancestor, giving total coordinate sum. An exact polynomial identity at the root gives the sum-of-squares branching decomposition by induction. Subtracting the fixed barycenter square gives the claimed normalized Euclidean radial formula for all n. Each local term is divisible by four, with minimal positive value four only at a balanced four-leaf subtree. Recursive one-leaf attachments classify and count precisely all two-shell equality cases. The included standalone exact checker independently reconstructs 82,499 tree profiles through n=11 and tests 2,401 root polynomial pairs; finite verification is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The canonical Loday associahedron is a natural Catalan polytope and its vertex metric about the known common barycenter is geometrically motivated independently of arithmetic enumeration. The theorem yields a universal structural nonnegative branching-defect decomposition, exact four-quantized squared radii and a sharp, dimension-independent first gap, plus complete equality trees and exponential multiplicities for both innermost shells. These are mathematically interpretable classifications not reducible to the already-known vertex centroid or facet inradius, with a potential use as an exact radial tree-imbalance filtration.
